decisions.reason: The Gallery requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording this asset as the temporary placeholder and storing its URL.
Selecting a temporary video asset does not change the homepage visual-design direction, image emphasis, or overlay settings.
The placeholder video decision does not alter the requirement to map relevant images to services on the Services page.
The video asset and its temporary role do not affect itemized service-pricing content or presentation.
The temporary video selection has no effect on package counts, square-footage categories, or package pricing.
Providing an external placeholder-video URL does not change the selected CMS, hosting provider, domain provider, or control panel.
The source concerns a video asset and does not change the rules governing client-supplied photographs, photo selection, or photo placement.
The selected placeholder video does not alter the required animation behavior of the homepage gallery.
The source identifies a video asset but does not change the destinations of the homepage section buttons.
Using a temporary video beside portfolio content does not change the requirement that homepage portfolio tiles link to the Gallery page.
The video asset decision does not affect the pricing-area entry or its destination.
The placeholder match is incidental; the source does not change the approved mobile pricing-table layout.
